descriptions.job-0y03wz7:
About Uphold

Uphold is a financial technology company that believes on-chain services are the future of finance. We provide modern infrastructure for on-chain payments, banking and investments. Offering Consumer Services, Business Services and Institutional Trading, Uphold makes pioneering financial services easy and trusted for millions of customers in more than 140 countries.

Uphold integrates with over 30 trading venues, including centralized and decentralized    exchanges, to deliver superior liquidity and optimal execution. Uphold never loans out customer assets and is always 100% reserved. The company pioneered radical transparency and uniquely publishes its assets and liabilities every 30 seconds on a public website (Transparency Page).

Uphold strips away the complexity to open up Web3 finance for everyone.

To learn more about Uphold, please visit https://uphold.com.

Job Summary

Uphold is looking for a CRM Platform Engineer (Customer.io)/CRM MarTech Manager to take full ownership of Customer.io, the platform we use to communicate with millions of customers across email, push, in-app and SMS.

This is a technical role, not a campaign execution role. You will own the data model, the integrations, the workflow architecture and the operating standards that make customer communication possible at scale. You will sit between Engineering, Data, Marketing and Commercial, and you will be the person who decides how the platform is built and how it is used.

The scope is wide. Uphold runs multiple products and regions on shared infrastructure, in a highly regulated industry, with a large volume of personal data. Getting this right means designing for reuse, for auditability and for safety, not just for the next campaign.

What you’ll be doing primarily

Own the CRM data foundation

  • Own the data layer inside Customer.io: Define and maintain the objects, attributes, events and identifiers that power the platform. Segmentation quality is a direct function of data quality, so this is the core of the role.
  • Work hand in hand with Engineering and Data: Design and maintain the pipelines that feed Customer.io. Agree on schemas, event contracts and data freshness requirements, and hold the line when they drift.
  • Guarantee freshness and correctness: Put monitoring and alerting in place so that stale, missing or malformed data is caught before it reaches a customer, not after.

Architect workflows that last

  • Apply systems thinking to campaign design: Build journeys, triggers and segments that are modular, reusable and understandable by someone who did not build them.
  • Prevent workflow sprawl: Establish naming conventions, versioning, documentation and deprecation routines. Retire what is no longer used. Treat the CRM workspace as a codebase, not a folder of one off campaigns.
  • Design for scale: Anticipate volume, message throughput, rate limits and platform constraints before they become production issues.

Operate with a multi product and multi brand mindset

  • Serve several products and brands from one platform: Design workspace structure, data models and templates so that Wallet, Topper, Enterprise and future brands share what should be shared and separate what must be separated.
  • Balance consistency with autonomy: Give each product team room to move without letting the overall architecture fragment.
  • Manage cross brand message pressure: Own global frequency capping, priority rules and suppression logic so customers receive a coherent experience across products.

Translate business objectives into CRM capability

  • Partner with Marketing and Commercial: Understand what the business is trying to achieve, then decide what the platform needs to look like to support it. Push back when a request is better solved a different way.
  • Turn requirements into architecture: Convert commercial goals into concrete data, segmentation and workflow design, with clear trade offs and sequencing.
  • Own the roadmap for the platform: Maintain a prioritised view of platform work and communicate it to stakeholders.

Enable marketing autonomy

  • Build for self sufficiency: Create templates, reusable components, documented segments and clear guardrails so marketing teams can launch routine work without engineering support.
  • Train and document: Run enablement sessions and maintain practical documentation. Success is measured by how much the teams can do without you, not by how much depends on you.
  • Set the guardrails: Define what marketers can change freely, what needs review, and what is locked. Make the safe path the easy path.

Drive automation and AI adoption

  • Identify automation opportunities: Look for manual, repetitive or error prone steps across the CRM operation and remove them.
  • Apply AI where it earns its place: Evaluate and implement AI for content generation, send time and channel optimisation, segmentation, anomaly detection and QA. Be pragmatic about where it adds value and where it does not.
  • Keep improving the operation: Measure the cycle time from business request to live campaign, and work it down.

Security and data protection first

  • Treat personal data with care: This is a PII heavy environment. Apply data minimisation, least privilege access, retention rules and clear handling standards by default.
  • Own consent and preferences: Maintain the consent, opt out and preference model, and make sure it is respected consistently across every channel and every brand.
  • Support compliance and audit: Work with Security, Privacy, Compliance and Legal on GDPR, access reviews, vendor risk and audit evidence. Be able to explain who received what, when, and on what basis.
  • Respect jurisdictional rules: Uphold operates under multiple regulatory regimes. Build the targeting and suppression logic that keeps communications compliant by market, including mandatory risk warnings and geographic restrictions on financial promotions.

Protect quality at the customer touchpoint

  • Be detail and quality obsessed: Every message is a direct customer touchpoint and a reflection of the brand. Own the QA process, including test sends, seed lists, rendering checks, link validation and pre send review.
  • Own deliverability: Manage domain and IP reputation, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), warm up, list hygiene, bounce and complaint rates. Deliverability is an engineering problem, and it belongs to this role.
  • Run change management: Define approval gates, no send windows, rollback procedures and incident response for communication failures.
  • Measure and improve: Own experimentation design, holdout groups and performance reporting, in partnership with the Data team.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • BS or advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in the field, with meaningful time spent owning a marketing automation, CRM or customer engagement platform in a technical capacity.
  • Hands-on experience with Customer.io, or a comparable platform such as Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, at an architecture and administration level rather than campaign execution only.
  • Strong SQL and comfort working with data warehouses and modern data pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, event driven data models and identity resolution.
  • Working knowledge of templating languages such as Liquid, plus HTML, CSS and JavaScript for email and in-app content.
  • Demonstrated systems thinking: the ability to design maintainable, scalable structures rather than solve each request in isolation.
  • Experience working with personal data under a security and privacy first approach, including consent management and GDPR.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non technical audiences.
  • Comfortable working across functions with Marketing, Commercial, Product, Data and Engineering.
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability and attention to detail.
  • Fluent written and oral English.


Salary: $150K + Bonus, Benefits 

Bonus if you have

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrencies or other digital assets, as they are core to our business.
  • Experience running CRM across multiple products or brands from a single platform.
  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms and reverse ETL tooling.
  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt or similar modern data stack tooling.
  • Practical experience applying AI tooling to marketing or CRM operations.
  • Deep email deliverability experience, including reputation management and remediation.
  • Experience integrating mobile SDKs for push and in-app messaging.
  • Community talks, certifications, and/or blog posts on your interests and research.
  • Open source project contributions of any kind.

Importantly, if you are looking for a senior role with us, you will have achieved many of the things above while also providing mentorship to others, and have engaged in public speaking opportunities.

What We Offer

  • Innovation and Impact: Contribute to pioneering projects in a dynamic and challenging environment.
  • Competitive Compensation: Performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits on top of a competitive salary.
  • Strong Company Culture: Thrive in a supportive, collegiate environment with values of integrity, teamwork, accountability, and excellence.
  • Global Collaboration: Participate in regular updates, strategy sessions, and networking opportunities across the group.
  • Development Opportunities: Access training and mentorship programs.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy options to work from home, other locations, or adjust your hours.
  • Inclusive Environment: Value and respect diverse perspectives.

Our Benefits

  • Annual bonus program based on individual, team and company performance.
  • Generous PTO, healthcare, and employee assistance programs.
  • Engaging events and celebrations.
  • Well-stocked office kitchen with a foodie culture.

Join us to grow, innovate, and contribute meaningfully. Be part of our talented team!

Visit our careers page for more exciting opportunities, if this role isn’t the perfect fit.

EEOC Employer

We're proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we celebrate our employees' differences, including race, color, religion, gender identity, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, and any other protected classes. Difference makes us stronger and better - together.
descriptions.job-0clev3n:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

Staff Product Manager, Prediction Markets (Sports)

Location: Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY
Job Type: Full-time

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Prediction Markets team’s mission is to create a compliant and engaging sports prediction platform where customers can trade on their knowledge. We are focused on building a seamless experience that brings the excitement of live sports data directly into our consumer application. Our team values deep collaboration, rigorous ethical standards, and high accountability for every product launch. We work closely with engineering, design, and compliance to bring these new sports prediction features to life!

As a Staff Product Manager for Sports Prediction Markets, you will lead the strategy and product lifecycle for our sports-focused prediction tools. You will guide the product definition, plan for major sporting events, and design how we package and present live sports data to our users. In this role, you will partner directly with senior leadership and key executives, navigating high-visibility projects while balancing consumer preferences with fintech regulations. Your work will directly expand our product offerings and introduce prediction markets to millions of customers. We are excited to welcome an experienced builder who is ready to shape the future of sports at Robinhood!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the product strategy and roadmap for sports-focused prediction markets, turning complex sports data into simple, intuitive consumer experiences.

  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, and compliance partners to define product requirements, navigate fintech constraints, and deliver highly compliant features.

  • Plan and execute product launches centered around major sporting events, ensuring robust market liquidity and high system reliability.

  • Incorporate feedback from senior executive reviews and user research to iterate on feature designs and improve platform engagement.

What you bring

  • Proven experience managing consumer-facing applications, with a strong background in sports-focused platforms, prediction markets, or gaming apps (such as DraftKings, FanDuel, or Underdog Sports).

  • Strong expertise in merchandising, presenting, and displays of live sports data to consumers in a highly engaging way.

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex regulatory environments and collaborate with compliance and legal partners to launch products.

  • Excellent communication skills to present product strategies and updates to executive leadership and align teams around shared goals.

  • Ability to adapt to evolving product requirements and thrive in a high-visibility, collaborative environment.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching

  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents

  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not

  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more

  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits

  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and are the world’s leading tokenizer of public equities. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue to grow the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced attorney to join our legal team as Senior Counsel, Commercial. This role will work closely with business development, partnerships, marketing, operations, and other commercial teams to structure, negotiate, and execute the agreements that support Ondo’s growth.

The Senior Counsel, Commercial will serve as a practical and commercially minded legal partner across a broad range of strategic relationships and transactions. This individual will lead negotiations, advise stakeholders on contractual and regulatory risk, and develop scalable processes that enable the business to move quickly while protecting Ondo’s interests.

The ideal candidate has significant experience negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements within financial services, fintech, blockchain, or another high-growth technology business. They should be comfortable managing complex negotiations independently, balancing legal risk with commercial objectives, and partnering closely with senior business stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary legal partner to business development, partnerships, marketing, operations, and other commercial teams
  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of agreements, including strategic partnerships, distribution, technology, licensing, vendor, service, referral, marketing, data, and confidentiality agreements
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations from initial structuring through execution and renewal
  • Advise stakeholders on contractual, regulatory, reputational, and counterparty risks associated with commercial initiatives
  • Support relationships with financial institutions, fintech companies, blockchain protocols, exchanges, wallets, custodians, market makers, technology providers, and other ecosystem partners
  • Develop pragmatic solutions that balance legal protection with commercial objectives and speed of execution
  • Advise marketing and business teams on promotional campaigns, partner communications, public claims, and related commercial arrangements
  • Partner with compliance and regulatory counsel to address issues involving securities, financial promotions, anti-money laundering, data protection, licensing, and geographic restrictions
  • Develop and maintain contract templates, negotiation playbooks, approval processes, and scalable commercial legal workflows
  • Provide training and guidance to business teams on contracting, negotiation, and risk management
  • Manage outside counsel and specialist advisers where appropriate
  • Support the AGC Commercial and other senior legal personnel on strategic transactions and business priorities

Requirements

  • JD degree from an accredited U.S. law school
  • 5–8+ years of legal experience at a major law firm and/or a high-growth blockchain, fintech, financial services, or technology company
  • Significant experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements
  • Strong understanding of commercial contracting principles, including liability, indemnification, intellectual property, data use, confidentiality, service levels, termination rights, and regulatory allocation
  • Experience advising business development, partnerships, marketing, sales, operations, or other commercial teams
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to provide clear, practical advice in situations involving competing business and legal considerations
  • Ability to lead negotiations independently and engage credibly with senior internal stakeholders and sophisticated counterparties
  • Understanding of the blockchain industry and the commercial relationships that support digital-asset or financial-services businesses
  • Familiarity with securities, anti-money laundering, financial promotions, data protection, and other relevant financial-services regulations
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation, analytical, and communication skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple transactions and deadlines simultaneously
  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment
  • Experience with tokenized assets, institutional financial products, or international commercial arrangements is a plus

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including but not limited to salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — We are well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO).
  • Remote-first team across many countries — You will be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices.
  • A+ colleagues — Our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Coinbase, Circle, Uniswap.
  • Best-in-class investors — We are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures.
descriptions.job-0o29m43:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Metronome, now part of Stripe, is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code.

Our platform computes millions of invoices per billing period and is scaling rapidly to accommodate new customers, saving them hours of development time and manual invoicing and enabling them to use consumption data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, NVIDIA, Confluent, and Anthropic.

What you’ll do

As a member of our technical support engineering team, you will be on the front lines providing world-class customer service. As part of our engineering organization, you will become an expert on our product and partner closely with Metronome's engineers, customer success, solutions architecture, and growth teams, as well as our customers' developers.

Your primary responsibilities will include handling customer escalations through our ticketing system, using internal observability tools to diagnose and scope customer-facing issues, collaborating directly with customers via Slack and other channels, and developing internal tools and documentation to improve the support experience. Since we view every support escalation as an opportunity to learn, both as individuals and as a company, you will play a critical role in providing feedback to our product team on common challenges and influencing our product roadmap.

Through your interactions with individual customers, you will help improve our product for everyone. Your work will play a crucial role in ensuring our customers' success and the continued effectiveness of their integration with Metronome.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical guidance to customers’ developers on best practices for integrating with our APIs and utilizing our functionality.
  • Troubleshoot any issues that arise from customers and diagnose any blockers. Escalate issues with customer context to the engineering team.
  • Develop internal tools to automate customer workflows that are currently unavailable in our product. Provide feedback on recurring patterns and advocate for addressing feature gaps in the product.
  • Design and assist in implementing a comprehensive knowledge base to assist customers with using our product.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 2+ years of work experience in a B2B customer-facing technical support organization or in engineering
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams and providing technical feedback on customer issues
  • Ability to debug and triage bugs and escalations from customers
  • Can communicate technical capabilities of the product to customers
  • Experience writing scripts or internal tools using APIs, and functional knowledge of SQL
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to break down complex technical concepts clearly
  • A mindset of customer empathy and ability to solve challenging problems

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience as an early or founding member of a support team, including building processes from scratch
  • Startup experience and familiarity with scaling a support team
  • Programming experience in one or more of Typescript, Python, or Ruby
  • You have worked on modern enterprise software which is business critical
  • Experience creating knowledge base articles and internal documentation
  • Familiarity with at least one ticketing system, such as Pylon, Zendesk, Front, or similar

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

Security is a primary competency at Coinbase, and the Threat Intelligence team within Security Operations keeps a watchful eye over every aspect of it. As a Senior Onchain Investigator, you'll own end-to-end onchain investigations into the threat actors targeting Coinbase and the crypto ecosystem. You'll cluster illicit wallets, fuse OSINT with onchain evidence, and turn findings into detections, blocks, and decisions that protect customers and products. This role leads investigation methodology for the team, not just individual cases.

What you'll do:

  • Own complex onchain investigations into threat actor infrastructure, scam networks, exploits, and related abuse targeting Coinbase and Base
  • Drive clustering and attribution of illicit actors using blockchain analytics, OSINT, and internal data, then operationalize results into Vertex Synapse and downstream controls
  • Build OSINT and onchain analysis pipelines, queries, and dashboards that automate detections and scale investigative capacity across the team
  • Lead post-incident reviews and root cause analyses to identify gaps and recommend enhancements to controls, detection, and overall security posture
  • Partner with product, engineering, and risk teams to embed threat and abuse mitigation strategies into the product development lifecycle from ideation to launch
  • Lead new investigative techniques, teach them across Security, and brief executives with clear risk, impact, and recommended actions

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of investigations including 3+ years investigating onchain illicit activity, cryptocurrency abuse, or blockchain intelligence, with a track record of independently leading investigations from collection through stakeholder action
  • Deep knowledge of blockchain ecosystems and protocols, including tracing across chains, bridges, mixers, and laundering patterns
  • Proficient with Python or Go and SQL for data analysis, scripting, or tooling development in support of intelligence workflows and automation
  • Track record of creating investigation methods, dashboards, or pipelines that other investigators adopt
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical analysis into clear, actionable intelligence for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive briefings
  • Skilled in conducting open-source intelligence (OSINT) research across a wide range of topics
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

The Head of Tax will report directly to the Global Controller and lead the company’s global tax function. This role will own tax strategy, governance, compliance, reporting, and planning across a growing multinational organization.

The Head of Tax will serve as the company’s primary tax subject-matter expert, partnering closely with Finance, Legal, Treasury, Product, and business leaders to ensure tax considerations are thoughtfully incorporated into new products, international expansion, transactions, and broader business decisions. This individual will also be responsible for developing scalable tax processes and controls that support the company’s continued growth and future public-company readiness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the company’s global tax function, including tax strategy, governance, risk management, compliance, reporting, and planning.
  • Manage U.S. federal, state, and international income tax compliance, including foreign reporting requirements and coordination of local-country filings.
  • Oversee indirect tax and withholding obligations, including sales and use tax, VAT/GST, and cross-border withholding taxes.
  • Own the annual and interim tax provision under U.S. GAAP and ASC 740, including deferred taxes, valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions, and related financial statement disclosures.
  • Develop and maintain a global tax compliance calendar, internal controls, policies, and supporting documentation appropriate for a scaling, audit-ready organization.
  • Lead tax planning related to legal entity structuring, capitalization, intercompany arrangements, repatriation, and expansion into new markets.
  • Develop and maintain transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, documentation, and implementation across the company’s international entities.
  • Assess permanent establishment, nexus, tax residency, and other risks arising from the company’s global operations and workforce.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Treasury, Product, and business operations teams to provide tax guidance on contracts, new products, regulated financial-services activities, and operational decisions.
  • Support M&A tax due diligence, transaction structuring, purchase accounting, and post-acquisition integration.
  • Manage tax authority inquiries, examinations, notices, and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate remediation.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory tax developments and communicate their potential financial, operational, and strategic impact to leadership.
  • Lead tax forecasting and cash-tax planning in coordination with FP&A and Treasury.
  • Oversee tax residency certificates, treaty-relief documentation, and related filings, including Forms 8802 and 6166.
  • Manage external tax advisors, including scope, budget, deliverables, and service quality, while developing scalable internal tax capabilities.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve tax efficiency, controls, data quality, processes, and automation.
  • Build and develop the internal tax function as the company’s needs and global footprint continue to expand.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA and/or Master’s in Taxation strongly preferred.
  • 8-10+ years of relevant tax experience, ideally combining public accounting and in-house corporate tax experience.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state taxation, with meaningful experience managing international tax matters and foreign entity compliance.
  • Strong knowledge of ASC 740 and demonstrated experience owning the tax provision process, including deferred taxes, valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions, and financial statement disclosures.
  • Experience overseeing tax matters across multiple legal entities and jurisdictions.
  • Experience with transfer pricing, intercompany arrangements, indirect taxes, withholding taxes, and international expansion.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement scalable tax policies, processes, and internal controls.
  • Experience managing external tax advisors, audits, tax authority matters, and competing filing deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and project-management skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple complex workstreams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain complex tax matters clearly to non-tax stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • A hands-on, collaborative approach and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Experience within a multinational fintech, financial-services, brokerage, or digital-assets business is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting M&A transactions and post-acquisition integration is preferred.
  • Public-company, pre-IPO, or SOX-readiness experience is a plus.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

At Block, we strive to build the best financial products in the world. The Financial Platform Issuing team owns the card issuing platform that serves every Block brand — powering Cash App Card, the fourth-largest debit card program in the US, alongside Square Card and the new card programs Block launches next.

We run the full lifecycle of a card: issuance, fulfillment, and activation; real-time transaction authorization and processing across card networks; digital wallet provisioning; 3-D Secure authentication; clearing and settlement; and disputes. When a customer taps their card at a register, our systems decide the outcome in milliseconds, around the clock, in partnership with card networks and bank partners.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Issuing server engineering team, you will bring deep card-network expertise to some of the most complex technical work on our roadmap. You will work alongside technical leads and cross functional teams, going deep where our platform meets the networks: specifications, protocols, certification, mandates, conformance, and production behavior.

This is a hands-on role. You will build systems and tooling, debug at the message level, and turn your network expertise into durable capabilities that other engineers can use. You will also work directly with the networks themselves — not only understanding what they require, but knowing where and how to influence outcomes for Block.

You Will

  • Be a deep technical expert on global card networks, helping Issuing teams interpret network specifications, message flows, certification requirements, mandates, and production behavior — and working directly with the networks to influence requirements, resolve ambiguity, and secure outcomes that matter for Block.
  • Lead complex, ambiguous engineering problems at the network boundary that span multiple teams, systems, or domains.
  • Partner with technical leads, program DRIs, and senior stakeholders to shape solutions where card-network requirements intersect with Block's issuing platform.
  • Stay deeply hands-on: write production code, build certification and conformance tooling, analyze network messages, review designs and code, and debug issues down to the protocol and field level.
  • Drive network certification and mandatory release cycles end to end, and translate network requirements into clear, pragmatic engineering decisions.
  • Establish shared frameworks, standards, tooling, and practices that make network expertise durable and enable teams to operate independently.
  • Raise the technical capability of engineers around you through design guidance, code reviews, mentorship, documentation, and clear technical judgment.
  • Apply AI-powered tools throughout the engineering lifecycle to improve velocity and quality, and help establish effective patterns for broader team use.
  • Share operational ownership of critical financial systems through on-call, incident response, and continuous improvements to reliability and correctness.

You Have

  • Deep, current expertise with at least one major card network, ideally Visa, including direct connectivity, ISO 8583, authorization and clearing flows, stand-in processing, specifications, certification, and mandate cycles.
  • Personally built, certified, or operated a live direct network connection — not only integrated through a processor.
  • Experience working directly with card networks to land concrete outcomes, such as rulings, exceptions, extensions, configuration changes, defect fixes, or certification outcomes.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience building and operating highly reliable financial or payments systems at scale.
  • A track record of leading technically complex, ambiguous work across team boundaries and influencing technical direction beyond your immediate area of ownership.
  • Experience creating durable technical leverage — frameworks, standards, tooling, architecture, or practices that other engineers and teams adopt.
  • Broad understanding of the card lifecycle, with depth in areas such as issuance and fulfillment, provisioning and activation, authorization, ledgering, clearing and settlement, reconciliation, disputes, or fraud.
  • Working knowledge of Mastercard and American Express, alongside deep expertise in at least one major network.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering workflows and sound judgment in evaluating and applying AI-generated output.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for critical financial systems.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Competitive Programs team, which is part of the Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategic Programs team, is a new team dedicated to establishing and scaling Stripe’s Competitive Programs capability. Stripe operates in a dynamic and evolving competitive landscape. This role will help Stripe understand market developments and translate competitive insights into actionable guidance for teams and users.

The Competitive Programs team works alongside Market Intelligence to help Stripe identify meaningful threats and opportunities early, mobilize coordinated action across the company in priority situations, and turn market and deal signals into better Product, Marketing, and GTM decisions. We build the competitive operating system—program design, cross-functional coordination, deal-routing mechanisms, visibility, and accountability—while Product, Sales, PMM, Pricing, and other functions retain ownership for decisions and delivery in their domains.

This is a full-stack program manager role. While the initial assignment is Competitive Programs, we are looking for a versatile program manager who can apply the same skills to other high-priority GTM initiatives as the team’s mandate and Stripe’s needs evolve.

What you’ll do

You will lead complex, C-suite level high-priority programs that require Stripe to move quickly and cohesively across functions. Initially, you will:

  • Build the foundations and operating mechanisms to turn ad hoc competitive programs into a repeatable, scalable playbook
  • Run one or more named competitive programs to protect strategic business, close recurring gaps, and pursue opportunities to take share
  • Partner with Stripe’s leadership to execute on initiatives to drive a strategic shift in company culture

You will be successful in this role if you can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear program with the right objectives, owners, decisions, operating cadence, and measures of success. You will be a trusted partner to executive leaders across Sales, Product, Product Operations, Marketing, Market Intelligence, Pricing, Finance & Strategy, and GTM Operations. You will not be expected to make Product roadmap, commercial-policy, or account-strategy decisions yourself; instead, you will ensure the right functional owners are engaged, accountable, and able to make decisions at the pace required.  You will need (1) superior communication skills to work across senior stakeholders from different functions and (2) are someone who thrives when solving complex problems with limited oversight.

Responsibilities

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket's finance team is small, high-output, and building the infrastructure that will support a category-defining company at scale. Reporting directly to the Controller, the Assistant Controller is a critical hire on a team where everyone owns their domain end to end. You won't be inheriting a finished system — you'll be inheriting a fast-moving business with real complexity, real regulatory exposure, and real expectations that the accounting function keeps pace with both.

The mandate is twofold: keep the close tight and build something that lasts. That means owning US GAAP reporting across multiple entities, maintaining and expanding our SOX control environment as we enter new product lines, and being the person who spots a gap in a workflow before it becomes a problem. We operate in regulated financial services with high transaction volume, crypto settlement flows, and active CFTC obligations — and if you're a CPA with deep fintech or financial services experience and the technical chops to apply ASC 606, ASC 805, and ASC 350-60 without needing someone to walk you through it, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process end to end under US GAAP, including consolidated financials and statutory filings for subsidiaries

  • Maintain and expand the SOX control environment as Polymarket launches new product lines and scales its US business, identifying control gaps before they become audit findings

  • Apply technical accounting standards independently across complex areas including revenue recognition (ASC 606), business combinations (ASC 805), and intangibles and crypto assets (ASC 350-60), and document conclusions clearly for both internal and external audiences

  • Partner with the Controller and legal and compliance teams on CFTC and other US regulatory filings, ensuring accuracy and timeliness

  • Scope and implement accounting system improvements, writing up process gaps, shipping fixes, and building workflows the team can actually rely on

  • Collaborate with product, legal, and business teams on new product launches, M&A activity, and monetization changes, providing accounting guidance before decisions are made

  • Manage and mentor junior accounting staff, setting a high bar for quality and helping the team grow without becoming a bottleneck

What We're Looking For

  • Active CPA license, required

  • 8–15 years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful time spent in banking, fintech, or regulated financial services

  • Hands-on experience with high transaction volume environments, including crypto on-ramps, stablecoin settlements, and fiat integrations, plus reconciliation workflows and error rate management

  • Demonstrated technical GAAP expertise across ASC 606, ASC 805, and ASC 350-60, applied independently in real situations

  • Direct experience with SOX compliance, including building and maintaining controls — not just operating within them

  • Direct experience with CFTC and other US financial regulatory filings

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can explain a complex accounting position to a non-accountant clearly

  • Management experience from a Big 4 firm, strongly preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel

  • (Plus) Experience with accounting system implementations from scoping through go-live

  • (Plus) SQL skills

  • (Plus) Prior experience at a high-growth startup where the infrastructure was still being built when you arrived

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $275,000 to $295,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

The Role

Block Information Security is an engineering-driven team focused on scaling security through innovation. Our Security Governance team designs and promotes the frameworks and standards that safeguard customer data, elevate security considerations across the company, and simplify regulatory and compliance obligations. The team also operates the agent-first platform that turns those frameworks into running systems.

Most of governance is a data problem. The risk, control, and asset information needed to answer "are we secure and compliant?" is dispersed across dozens of systems: source control, service registries, identity providers, data warehouses, ticketing, CI/CD. GRC Engineers treat that as an engineering problem. You'll build the data pipelines, integrations, and agentic AI workflows that turn manual governance processes into products that run continuously, produce measurable results, and hold up to audit end to end.

You Will

  • Build and operate the pipelines and integrations that aggregate, normalize, and join risk, control, and asset signals from systems of record across Block, including source control, the service registry, identity, ticketing, data platforms, and CI/CD
  • Translate security standards and compliance requirements into policy-as-code: enforceable, testable rules that run continuously. For example, "every production service has an accountable owner" becomes a versioned, tested check instead of a quarterly spreadsheet
  • Design agentic AI workflows that pair LLM reasoning with deterministic, auditable decision layers for evidence analysis, control monitoring, classification, and assessment
  • Build the evals, benchmarks, and calibration harnesses that keep automated governance honest
  • Automate evidence collection and continuous control monitoring to replace point-in-time audit preparation
  • Define the technical approach for ambiguous, cross-team problem spaces. This is an early-stage program, and you will frame problems as often as you solve them
  • Partner with Security Governance Partners, Compliance, and Engineering teams to find the manual processes most worth turning into product
  • Help govern Block's own AI systems: the same platform that automates governance also assesses the autonomy and safety of Block's agents
  • Contribute to technical design discussions, evaluating the security and reliability properties of the platform itself

You Have

  • 7+ years building production software in backend, platform, data, or security engineering
  • Multi-year ownership of a production system, including on-call, SLOs, and the maintenance work that starts after launch
  • Proficiency with at least one of Python, Kotlin, Java, or Go, and comfort reading unfamiliar codebases
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs (prompting, tool use, agents, or LLM-backed features) and opinions about where model judgment belongs and where it doesn't. Judgment matters more here than volume
  • Experience with integration patterns: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication flows, event-driven architectures
  • Experience pulling, normalizing, and joining data from multiple imperfect sources, and handling the edge cases gracefully
  • Experience defining technical direction where the problem was ambiguous, and carrying it across team boundaries
  • Attention to detail balanced with pragmatism about risk-based prioritization

Nice to have (optional):

  • Working knowledge of a security or compliance framework such as PCI DSS, SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST. Prior GRC experience is not required; we can teach the governance side
  • Production-scale LLM or agentic systems experience

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Middle Office Operations team is committed to providing a superior customer journey while mitigating institutional risk and facilitating the execution of innovative brokerage services. We provide essential support for our various trading platforms by managing central middle-office operations, ensuring transaction accuracy, and overseeing vital risk-related functions.

As a Middle Office Operations Margin Specialist, you’ll be responsible for account level risk management and operations. You’ll perform essential daily duties to keep our margin business running smoothly, including analyzing and resolving various types of margin calls, communicating with customers via phone or email to resolve escalated issues, reviewing risk-based alerts, testing the functionality of our margin product, and reviewing our outbound communications and educational materials. Additionally, you’ll be expected to help scale our processes, tools, documentation, and workflows, and be a key member in helping us grow our team. Along with the broader Middle Office Operations team, you’ll work cross-functionally with our clearing, product, compliance, international, and engineering teams to improve operational efficiency, manage critical events effectively, and maintain our high-quality standards.

This role is based in our Denver, CO, Chicago, IL, Lake Mary, FL, and New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Review daily margin calls and execute the firm's margin sellout process.
  • Recovery efforts across multiple entities to ensure accurate and timely reconciliation.
  • Leverage AI-driven initiatives to improve workflows, automate routine tasks, and enhance operational accuracy.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert during critical system outages or issues, participating in the weekly on-call rotation and remaining available outside standard business hours, including early mornings or late evenings, to ensure timely resolution
  • Drive testing of new products and conduct routine testing for existing processes to ensure stability and compliance.
  • Research, prioritize, and resolve margin-related escalations in a timely and compliant manner.
  • Mitigate firm and customer risk through intraday alert monitoring and proactively resolve account issues.
  • Partner with clearing, engineering, product, and international teams to drive efficiency, enhance the margin offering, and ensure consistent onboarding and operational standards, while fostering a collaborative culture of knowledge sharing and continuous team development.
  • Monitor and manage margin interest rates, ensuring accuracy and consistency across accounts, while assisting with the implementation of negotiated and promotional rate programs.
  • Maintain detailed records in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOPs) and contribute to ongoing updates and improvements to SOPs and Help Center articles to ensure accuracy and clarity.
  • Ensure adherence to firm procedures and industry regulations at all times.

What you bring

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • FINRA Series 7 and Series 63
  • Understanding of equities and option strategies
  • Demonstrated proficiency with technology and data-driven tools, with a forward-thinking approach to automation and process improvement.
  • Strong analytical skills, including critical thinking and data analysis. Comfortable leveraging digital tools to solve complex problems and drive efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of Regulation T and FINRA Rule 4210, including their application to margin requirements and risk management.
  • Strong knowledge of Robinhood's products
  • Experience with retail client margin calls
  • Bonus: FINRA Series 24

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.

  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

descriptions.job-17sr19v:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be part of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: Multistakeholder, Mindfulness, Driven by Excellence and High Integrity. Circlers are consistently evolving in a remote world where strength in numbers fuels team success. We have built a flexible and diverse work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for

As a Senior Accountant on our Regulatory Reporting team, you will own end-to-end accounting and reporting for assigned entities and cost areas, including close, reporting, and controls. You will take full ownership of the month-end close process related to your areas, including statutory and regulatory reporting requirements. Your work will support internal and external reporting, inform business decisions, and improve operational efficiency through automation, AI-powered tools, and cross-functional collaboration. This is a role for someone highly organized, meticulous, deadline-conscious, and accountable — you keep complex, multi-entity workstreams accurate and audit-ready without being asked twice.
 

What you'll work on

  • Prepare statutory and regulatory reporting for multiple legal entities across the jurisdictions in which Circle operates.

  • Perform month-end close procedures, including but not limited to preparing management accounts, posting period-end journal entries, performing reconciliations, and reviewing auto-matched transactions within the ERP system.

  • Analyze fluctuations in key balance sheet and P&L accounts to ensure data accuracy and completeness.

  • Prepare support for SEC disclosures and other external financial reporting.

  • Review agreements to ensure accounting complies with U.S. GAAP, IFRS, and any local reporting requirements.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify and implement process improvements, including automation and AI-based enhancements.

  • Own and continuously improve control design and execution, including documentation, testing readiness, and identification of control gaps in line with ICFR/SOX expectations.

  • Take ownership of SOX, audit, and tax compliance efforts by maintaining detailed documentation, proactively managing requests, and influencing outcomes where appropriate.

  • Contribute to special projects and ad hoc accounting analyses as needed.

  • Leverage AI tools and automation platforms to reduce manual processes, improve reporting quality, and increase efficiency in close and reconciliation workflows.
     

What you'll bring to Circle

Core requirements

  • 4+ years of relevant accounting experience, whether in Big 4 audit or in-house at a technology, fintech, or financial institution. Prior experience working with or for publicly traded companies is preferred.

  • ACA / CPA / ACCA or equivalent qualification.

  • Working knowledge of IFRS is required; knowledge of U.S. GAAP is strongly preferred.

  • A good grasp of regulatory reporting, including requirements for financial institutions.

  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail — you keep accurate, audit-ready records across multiple entities and reporting streams.

  • Deadline-conscious, with a proven ability to deliver high-quality work on tight close and reporting timelines while managing competing priorities in a demanding, fast-paced environment.

  • High accountability and ownership — you follow through on your commitments and own outcomes end to end.

  • Demonstrated ability to execute complex reconciliations and variance analyses.

  • Comfortable learning and working with modern AI tools and automation platforms to enhance productivity, accuracy, and process efficiency.

  • Works independently and collaboratively with a global team across various time zones.

  • Professional-level English communication, both written and spoken.
     

Preferred requirements

  • Understanding of blockchain technology and digital assets.

  • Hands-on experience with automation tools and AI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, N8N or similar tools used in accounting workflows.

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion (or a comparable ERP), Slack, and Google Workspace.

  • Experience working cross-functionally in a remote-first, high-growth environment.

descriptions.job-184pqer:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

At TRM Labs, our Deployment Strategy team sits on the front lines of customer success, turning blockchain intelligence into measurable outcomes for the crypto businesses, financial institutions, and fintechs that rely on TRM. As a Senior Deployment Strategist for the North America private sector, you will own a portfolio of strategic commercial accounts, validate what success means for each customer, and drive adoption, retention, and expansion as their trusted advisor. What makes this role unique at TRM is the blend of senior IC autonomy, direct access to the economic buyers shaping crypto compliance programs, and the mandate to build the private-sector playbooks the rest of the team will run.

The impact you will have:

  • Own the success of TRM's most strategic North America private-sector accounts, using AI (e.g., Claude) to turn customer calls and account data into 30/60/90-day success plans you validate against a named OSM and Economic Buyer.

  • Protect and grow private-sector revenue: defend GRR by getting ahead of churn, and surface and validate expansion opportunities as CSQLs with Account Directors to grow NRR.

  • Cut QBR and executive-briefing prep from days to hours by using AI to draft briefs, decks, and follow-ups that you refine with your own judgment.

  • Catch risk and opportunity early by using AI to triage customer-health and usage signals across your book daily.

  • Make the whole team faster by building reusable AI prompts, templates, and workflows that other Deployment Strategists adopt.

  • Serve as the Voice of the Customer, using AI to synthesize feedback from calls and tickets into structured input that shapes the Product and Engineering roadmap.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years in crypto businesses, financial institutions, or fintechs (compliance, investigative, or customer-facing functions), with a habit of using AI tools to work faster.

  • Hands-on financial crime, AML, sanctions, or investigations experience, and comfort applying AI to accelerate research and case work.

  • A track record of owning senior stakeholder relationships and driving retention and expansion, supported by AI-assisted account planning and reporting.

  • Fluency using AI tools (e.g., Claude) to accelerate research, drafting, and analysis, with sound judgment on when to trust vs verify output.

  • Ability to build reusable AI-assisted workflows and templates that scale beyond yourself.

  • Clear communication that distills complex technical and investigative concepts for audiences from analysts to senior executives.

About the Team:

  • TRM's Customer Success org is globally distributed and works async-first, thriving on Slack and thorough documentation, with weekly customer syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, and regular pod calls.

  • The North America Deployment Strategy pod owns the private-sector book (crypto businesses, financial institutions, and fintechs) and operates as trusted advisors, not a ticket queue.

  • The work is intellectually demanding: you engage compliance and investigations leaders as a peer, reason about real financial crime, and translate it into product value.

  • The team sets a high bar on AI fluency, expecting every DS to use AI as a force multiplier and to share what works.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: async-first collaboration with core overlap for North America hours.

  • Weekly customer syncs and bi-weekly customer-health syncs.

  • Regular pod calls and customer QBRs.

  • Slack and written documentation are the primary communication tools.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Core overlap during North America business hours; HM to confirm exact hours at intake.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Schedule: Occasional off-hours monitoring for P0/P1 customer issues (not a formal on-call rotation).

  • Frequency: Light and shared across the team; HM to confirm exact cadence at intake. Regional compliance: United States is clear to proceed; if hired in Canada, confirm provincial on-call rules via Deel before posting.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Occasional.

  • Frequency: For in-person customer meetings, trainings, QBRs, or events across North America; HM to confirm expected cadence at intake.

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: None specified; this role is remote and distributed.

  • Frequency: N/A.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first week with an existing customer, you capture their internal success metrics (OSMs) and draft a 30/60/90-day success plan to achieve them, using AI to turn the call into a first draft.

  • Within the same day a customer reports a bug, you coordinate across Product and Engineering to get answers and a fix, and close the loop with the customer.

  • Within the same day you spot an expansion signal on a call, you validate it against CSQL criteria and log the CSQL with the Account Director.

The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role:

Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

The estimated base salary range for this role is $127,000-$177,000

Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more: Interviewing at TRM: How We Hire and What Success Looks Like

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

What We're Looking For
